alt: A short film for Stories, no voice. A pink entryway with a cream door. A cobalt block figure with white eyes leans toward the door and knocks twice. The door opens a little and a second small block figure peeks out, both eyes in the opening, happy to see who is there. The sentence stays on screen: knock knock. you go first.
